fields.Name: Predictive Studio Gates — Registry and Gate
fields.Description: The PR 4 registry and lifecycle-gate gates: G3.1 (a lost artifact refuses loudly; a kept one scores bit-identically across a sidecar restart), G3.2 (a swapped artifact is refused by SHA-256 mismatch), G3.3 (five out-of-gate Status writes are refused), G3.5 (a retrained challenger does not replace the incumbent on the unchanged data), G3.6 (every Published model has a complete publish record), G3.7 (10 sampled numbers of the C1 report and trust line recompute from their stored rows), G3.8 (the W1 s42 agent report states the selection score and leakage result from stored rows, with no fixed "honest holdout" sentence and no cvScore), G3.10 (the C3 multiclass semantics check passes for 3 of 3 classes and a swapped adverse-class binding is refused) and G3.11 (an agent's write of a guard field or a stored leakage flag is refused). Needs MJAPI (STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT set, PREDICTIVE_STUDIO_SIDECAR_URL at the truth sidecar), the truth sidecar running (pnpm run truth:sidecar, which writes .run/sidecar.url and .run/sidecar.pid) and `pnpm run truth:provision` done; the mj test process needs STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT too. Run with: MJ_INTEGRATION_TEST=1 RUN_MUTATION_TESTS=1 pnpm mj test suite "Predictive Studio Gates — Registry and Gate"
